definitions.full: H7973. shelach I. שֶׁ֫לַח noun [masculine] missile, weapon, sprout (late); — absolute ׳שׁ Joel 2:8 +, שָׁ֑לַח Neh 4:11 ; Job 33:18 , suffix שִׁלְחוֺ Neh 4:17 ; plural שְׁלָחִים 2Chr 23:10 , etc.; — 1 missile, weapon , Neh 4:11 and 4:17 (where הַמַּיִם corrupt; read probably בִּימִינוֺ or בְּיָדוֺ ; see Ryle BeRy Berthol), 2Chr 23:10 (distinguished from מָנֵן חֲנִית, ); collective 32:5 and בַּשׁ ׳עָבַר Job 33:18 ; 36:12 ( perish by or < rush upon [and perish]), Joel 2:8 (see בְּעַד ). 2 sprout, shoot (compare [ שְׁלוּחָה ], and √ Psa 80:12 ; Jer 17:8 ), מַּרְדֵּס שְׁלָחַיִךְ Song 4:13 (figurative; meaning ? Perles Anal. 63 proposes לְחָיָיִךְ שְׁנֵי thy two cheeks ); + probably Ezek 31:5 (read בִּשְׁלָחָיו Co Toy and others, or בְּשִׁלְחֵי [with 31:6 ] Krae).
